svg.text: this deployment · one CloudFormation root stack
15 VPC endpoints · NAT only for cross-region calls
one per connected account · can be the agent account
How an operator's chat, investigations, dashboard and scans reach the databases, and what stores the results
Learning agent runs in the API
The operator signs in with Amazon Cognito (TOTP required) and loads the operator app from CloudFront, behind AWS WAF (on by default; created in a
us-east-1 edge stack when the deployment is elsewhere).
REST calls (dashboard, investigations, trends, topology, reports, sessions) go through API Gateway with a JWT authorizer, over a VPC Link to the internal
ALB and the FastAPI service on ECS Fargate.
Chat and investigation turns stream straight to the Bedrock AgentCore Runtime (/invocations, JWT-authorised); the orchestrator or the investigation agent
runs there and conversations persist in AgentCore Memory.
Agents call Claude on Amazon Bedrock, with the optional Bedrock Guardrails screening input and output; the research agent's web search goes through the
Specialists assume a read-only, ExternalId-bound role in the database account for CloudWatch, Performance Insights and CloudTrail, fetch the read-only
user's credentials from Secrets Manager, and connect to PostgreSQL over VPC peering or PrivateLink.
EventBridge Scheduler runs the Tier 1 collector (Lambda, every 5 minutes) and the Tier 2 deep scan (AWS Batch) per database; both write their records to
the DynamoDB metrics tables and publish the numerics to CloudWatch, and the scan's HTML report lands in S3.
A finished scan notifies SNS; a Lambda calls POST /api/learn with a machine token, and the Learning agent compares the scan against history and raises or
The API keeps one CloudWatch alarm per database per enabled alarm on the Tier 1 series (collection failing, XID wraparound, connection saturation, long
transactions, lock contention, deadlocks, replica lag, cache hit). A state change goes through an EventBridge rule to the alarm notifier, which emails
the notification address as HTML over SES, or plain text over SNS.
Diagram uses the AWS Architecture Icons (aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons).
